# S93 — Read only the sections an agent implements against

`show ID --section NAME` reads back one section, but an agent that wants the boundary
plus acceptance still pulls the whole ~4 KB slice. Let `--section` take several names,
or add a projection (e.g. `--implement`) returning just boundary + acceptance + deps,
so the agent reads exactly what it codes against instead of the full slice.
